description: This file contains database migration scripts for the 'superset' project, specifically related to upgrading and downgrading filter box slices by modifying their parameters.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a database table 'slices' with columns for id, params, viz_type, and slice_name.

methods.name: upgrade_slice
methods.description: Modifies the 'params' of a Slice object to upgrade filter configurations by transforming 'groupby' and 'metric' into 'filter_configs'.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process on all 'filter_box' slices in the database, applying 'upgrade_slice' to each.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the upgrade changes on 'filter_box' slices, restoring 'groupby' and 'metric' from 'filter_configs'.
